item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hi there! It's Tuesday, November 24. Time for the weather! Tuesday already. Well done for a good start! Today in Shanghai, it will be damp with light drizzle. The high will be 12 degrees, and the low will be 5 degrees. There's a real chill in the air today. Rain is very unlikely today. Here's something to notice: today is about 5 degrees cooler than yesterday. Will you need an extra layer? Brrr, it's chilly. Don't forget your scarf! As for tomorrow, expect it to be overcast, with a high of 12 degrees. What would you tell a friend about rain on the window? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
